resources.string: Sign in and continue learning your way.
A small beginning for everything you want to understand.
Already have an account? Sign in
I agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Notice.
Please read and accept the terms before creating an account.

AI Mentor supports learning; it does not replace teachers or your own thinking. AI responses may be inaccurate, so check textbooks and reliable sources.

Your account, profile and learning progress are stored through Supabase. Some data may be cached on this device for convenience. Questions or images you send to AI are shared with the configured AI service. Only share content you have permission to use, and avoid sending unnecessary private information.

Your display name, grade, subjects and profile note personalize your experience; the profile note may be visible to other learners. You can edit these details in Profile.
Use an email you can access. Gmail is not required.
At least 8 characters, an uppercase letter and a number; up to 72 UTF-8 bytes.
Use 2 to 80 characters for your display name.
We could not create an account with these details. Check them or try signing in.
Your account will be signed out on this device. Synced learning progress will remain saved.
Learn smarter, at your own pace.\n\nExplore Grade 10 subjects with a learning path for each one. When a question gets tricky, you have a companion to help you work through it.
Learn with AI, understand it your way
Ask a question or share a photo of a problem.\n\nExplore step-by-step explanations, save notes and revisit conversations. AI features need a connection and a configured service.
Every student has their own journey
Choose your grade, interests and goals to record your learning direction.\n\nTake quizzes, review saved questions offline and see EXP and activity on your Dashboard.
Ready to begin your learning journey?
Try thinking it through yourself, then check AI answers.\n\nShare only the questions and images you need for learning. Revisit this guide in Settings and edit account details in Profile.
A few choices to record your focus. No address or phone number needed.
